title: Track 1 Market View / strategy charts + Regime Monitor

todays_bars_are_not_persisted.why: the store is appended once a day; the live half of each session is spliced IN MEMORY inside the slot process and thrown away
todays_bars_are_not_persisted.consequence: the overnight sleeve fetched and used 1910 of today's bars and not one survives on disk; a chart captioned 'today' would be empty on every normal day
todays_bars_are_not_persisted.what_the_panel_does: shows the most recent session the store actually covers and SAYS which session that is, in the summary and in the payload

no_prices_and_no_score.strategy: every rule in the signal diagnostics carries source=not_exposed_by_sleeve with a null value; there is no entry, stop, target or reference price anywhere in the evidence
no_prices_and_no_score.model: label_regimes returns a series of strings - no score, probability or shift threshold underneath the label
no_prices_and_no_score.what_the_panel_does: says 'entry levels not exposed by sleeve evidence yet' and 'not exposed by model' in those words
no_prices_and_no_score.why_not_approximate: a line drawn at a level nobody published is a line an operator would trade against

measured_first.and_its_consumer: shared/live.js guards `if (!window.Chart) return` with an inline-SVG fallback - the codebase already treats an external chart lib as optional

part_c_dependency.decision: first-party SVG, in the same style as the sparkline already in shared/live.js

tradeoff_stated.cdn_script_on_this_page: this is the page an operator watches a live trading route on; a third-party host becomes a dependency at exactly the moment something is going wrong
tradeoff_stated.vendoring: commits a third-party blob into a repo that has none - a supply-chain decision for the owner, not for this stage
tradeoff_stated.cost_of_the_choice: crosshair, tooltip, price scale and time axis hand-drawn - roughly 200 lines a library would have provided
tradeoff_stated.swap_is_small: the payload shape already matches what Lightweight Charts consumes

live_correction_to_5ZZI.5zzi_recorded: every fetch from 03:05 ET returned zero rows
live_correction_to_5ZZI.now: the 12:30 Stress observation reads live_rows_fetched=2490, splice_result=ok
live_correction_to_5ZZI.conclusion: the feed RECOVERED during the Stress window; the outage was bounded, not ongoing

part_b_payload.why_its_own_endpoint: it slices instrument stores; /track1-runtime is polled on a short interval by a page that needs it to stay cheap

field_sources.bars: instrument parquet, day-sliced, resampled to 5m, clipped to the sleeve context range, cached by (path, mtime, day)
field_sources.slots: signal-diagnostics rows married to the slot table so slots that have not fired appear as `future`
field_sources.levels: scanned from rule_checks where source == measured - EMPTY today, written as a scan so the day a detector publishes a price the line appears without anyone editing the file
field_sources.data_status: the data-observation row, including the provider_error Stage 5ZZI wired in
field_sources.regime: the recorded regime label, never computed in the request

part_b_payload.calm_excluded: a two-phase one-shot contract; a candle chart of a single decision instant would draw a window it does not have

regime_recorder.why_not_computed_on_request: label_regimes takes 8.54 SECONDS measured; a dashboard endpoint calling it would hang the operator's page for that long on the first poll after every SPY refresh and on every cold backend
regime_recorder.pattern: a probe measures and writes down what it saw; the reader reads what the probe wrote - the same shape as track1_b1, track1_account_baseline and regime_verify
regime_recorder.why: Calm is the permissive regime; a labeller that could not run must not read like one that answered 'safe'
regime_recorder.why_that: a label without the fit window that produced it is a label nobody can reproduce - the FreezeRecord mistake this project already made once

defects_caught_by_measuring.what: two definitions of 'observed' on one page
defects_caught_by_measuring.detail: the summary counted slot markers and printed 24/24 for a sleeve the window ledger recorded as 18 of 24 - a refused slot leaves a row here and is not an observation there
defects_caught_by_measuring.fix: the count comes from the ledger; the markers only draw

defects_caught_by_measuring.what: 'Data refused' printed over a working feed
defects_caught_by_measuring.detail: any provider_reason was treated as a refusal, so Swing - which had simply not opened yet - was labelled a data problem
defects_caught_by_measuring.fix: ok is None means nobody looked; only ok is False reads as refused

defects_caught_by_measuring.detail: the fact-row CSS was scoped to #track1Facts, so the regime panel reused the markup and inherited none of it: label inline at 14px instead of block at 11px, producing 'RegimeCalm as of 2026-08-26' on the page
defects_caught_by_measuring.found_by: comparing computed styles against the Track 1 panel, not by looking at a screenshot
defects_caught_by_measuring.fix: both selectors named in one rule

defects_caught_by_measuring.what: the render calls landed inside the ISSUE-ROW CLICK HANDLER, not the render pipeline
defects_caught_by_measuring.detail: the panels only appeared after clicking an issue
defects_caught_by_measuring.found_by: the DOM tests timing out waiting for tabs that were never drawn - a code-read would have shown a call in the file and looked correct

layout_measured_in_browser.regime_row_text: REGIME | Calm as of 2026-08-26 · read 0.3h ago | LABEL CHECK | PASS · 1761 compared, none changed | SCORE | not exposed by model

values_not_exposed: entry / stop / target / reference price - every sleeve, no rule publishes a number
regime score - the model returns strings
distance to a regime shift - nothing to compute it from
today's bars - not persisted; the stored session is named instead

frontend_computes_nothing.why_scoped: the page has long-standing prose that NAMES the model ('The HMM stale guard is hard-tripped'); a whole-file search fails on a label rather than on a computation, which is exactly how the first version of that test failed
frontend_computes_nothing.timestamps: split as strings rather than parsed with Date - these are wall-clock on the sleeve's own exchange clock and a Date would reinterpret them in the viewer's zone, the thirteen-hour class of error this project has already paid for once

my_own_test_bugs_found_and_fixed: a whole-file search for 'HMM' matched pre-existing PROSE rather than a computation
an NKD fixture generated 09:30 bars for a 01:10-02:55 window, so no bar fell inside the band and the band test failed on the fixture
an assertion pinned to rendered casing when CSS uppercases the empty-state heading
registrations_the_existing_tests_demande: the new endpoint added to the realtime endpoint contract
the new endpoint added to the shared DOM fixture - an unstubbed route shows up as a console 404 and fails the healthy-page test
the contract list-slot was pinned to `sleeves`, which is a dict; caught immediately and repointed at regime.recent / regime.context

restated.why: Stage 5ZZK closed B1, so pinning it as blocking asserts a state the route has moved past
restated.now: asks the registry for whatever is blocking and requires something to compare against

safety.backend_restart_reason: /api/v1/track1-market-view is a new route; the running process does not have it
safety.page_handles_its_absence: the fetch is independent; a failure leaves every other panel exactly as it was
runtime_files_written_by_this_stage: global_index/track1_runtime/regime_label/regime_label_20260827.jsonl (new evidence directory, written by the regime probe)
